verses.text: For the music director. A psalm by David. God I praise, don’t stay quiet.
Wicked people are opening their mouths against me, and every word they say to me is a lie.
They’ve boxed me in with hateful words and come after me for no reason.
I showed them love, and they turned against me. I keep praying.
They pay back my good with evil and answer my love with hate.
Put a wicked man over him. Let an accuser stand at his right hand.
When he goes to trial, let him be found guilty. Let even his prayer be counted as sin.
Let his days be few. Give his position to someone else.
Let his children lose their father and his wife become a widow.
Let his children roam around begging. Let them be driven out of their ruined homes.
Let the lender seize everything he owns. Let strangers take everything he worked for.
Let nobody show him kindness or take pity on his fatherless children.
Let his family line be cut off. Let their name be erased in the next generation.
Let the LORD remember what his ancestors did wrong. Don’t erase his mother’s sin.
Keep their wrongs before the LORD so he can wipe their memory off the earth.
He never thought to show kindness. He went after the poor, the needy, and the brokenhearted to kill them.
He loved cursing people, and the curse came back on him. He took no joy in blessing, and blessing stayed far away from him.
He wore curses like clothes. They soaked into him like water, like oil seeping into his bones.
Let those curses cling to him like the clothes he wears and the belt he keeps around his waist.
Let this be what the LORD gives my enemies, those who speak evil against my life.
But help me for the sake of your name, Lord GOD. Your faithful love is good, so rescue me.
I’m poor and needy, and my heart is wounded.
I’m fading like a shadow at dusk. I get shaken off like a locust.
My knees are weak from fasting. My body is thin and wasted.
They mock me too. When they see me, they shake their heads.
Help me, LORD my God. Save me because of your faithful love.
Let them see that it was your hand, that you, LORD, did this.
They can curse me, but you bless me. When they rise against me, they’ll be put to shame, and your servant will celebrate.
Dress my enemies in disgrace. Let them wrap themselves in their own shame like a robe.
I’ll thank the LORD out loud again and again. I’ll praise him in the middle of the crowd.
He stands at the right hand of the needy, ready to save them from those who would sentence them to death.
